# preview-report-template-writer

Purpose: Generate the structured preview-report Markdown that glb-web-handoff and non-blender-user-response-writer consume after a render or export run.

Standardize how a preview / render / export run's evidence is summarized so that downstream skills (handoff, final response writer) consume a known schema instead of re-parsing free-form text.

Metadata: Category `evidence-and-handoff` | Role `stakeholder-preview-packet-formatter` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- after `render-export-evidence` produces measurements
- before `glb-web-handoff` is composed
- before `non-blender-user-response-writer` writes the final summary
- Trigger phrases: "summarize the render", "write up the export evidence", "what's the preview status"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- measuring artifacts directly → use `render-export-evidence` (`references/skill-render-export-evidence.md`; use render-export-evidence instead)
- raw debug logs or crash triage → use `blender-troubleshooting` (`references/skill-blender-troubleshooting.md`; use blender-troubleshooting instead)
- gating handoff readiness → use `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skill-pre-handoff-verification.md`; use pre-handoff-verification instead)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `classified_artifact_evidence` (`object`): Verified or Produced artifact evidence record from render-export-evidence
- Required input `quality_checker_summary` (`object`): Pass/Warn/Fail summary from blender-scene-quality-checker and specialist validators
- Optional input `known_visual_caveats` (`array`): Optional non-blocking visual warnings or pending stakeholder review questions
- Output contract: `stakeholder_preview_evidence_packet`, `truth_state_and_provenance_summary`, `pre_handoff_gate_submission` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. pick the report kind (`preview` / `render` / `export` / `full`)
2. copy measured values and truth labels from `render-export-evidence` (downgrade-only, never upgrade)
3. attach artifact paths and runtime path (`Path 1 host a` / `Path 1 host b` / `Path 2` / `CLI`) per row verbatim
4. mark unmeasured or unproduced fields as `Not Run` / `Not Produced` (no-run reports are full `Not Run` / `Not Produced` placeholders)

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [upstream_reference] Measured evidence input (supplies measurements + truth states) → `render-export-evidence` (`references/skill-render-export-evidence.md`)
- [progression] Handoff gate (gates handoffs before downstream delivery) → `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skill-pre-handoff-verification.md`)
- [progression] Web handoff consumer → `glb-web-handoff` (`references/skill-glb-web-handoff.md`)
- [progression] Final non-Blender user response consumer → `non-blender-user-response-writer` (`references/skill-non-blender-user-response-writer.md`)
- [fallback] Raw debug log triage (out of scope here) → `blender-troubleshooting` (`references/skill-blender-troubleshooting.md`)

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: This skill is documentation only. It never runs Blender, renders, exports, or parses logs (`render-export-evidence` supplies measurements; `blender-troubleshooting` owns raw debug logs). It only formats existing evidence into the canonical schema. If the run did not happen, the report is a full placeholder with every artifact at `Not Run` / `Not Produced`.
- Run Blender.
- Render or export.
- Parse log files (out of scope; consume measurement output of `render-export-evidence`).
- Promote a label without evidence.
